title: POLICY: Teachings Default to safe_to_auto_adopt: true
summary: All teachings distributed by the framework should default to `safe_to_auto_adopt: true`. Manual approval gates slow framework velocity. If a teaching isn't safe to auto-adopt, it shouldn't be distributed. Exception: CRITICAL teachings that block other processing (like audit) — still auto-adopt, but with blocking rule.

policy.default: Every teaching created by framework has `safe_to_auto_adopt: true` by default
rationale: Framework curates teachings before distribution — if it's distributed, it's vetted
Manual approval gates every update — this breaks framework velocity
Trust the distribution. If teaching is unsafe, don't distribute it
Auto-adoption enables continuous framework evolution across all spokes
policy.exception: CRITICAL teachings may have blocking rules (like audit), but still auto-adopt. Blocking happens AFTER adoption, not before.

teaching_authoring_requirement: Every new teaching MUST include: `safe_to_auto_adopt: true` (default)
If you believe a teaching should NOT auto-adopt, escalate to framework team — it may not be ready for distribution
Reasoning: if there's doubt, either: (a) fix the teaching until you're confident, or (b) don't distribute it yet
template_requirement: Every new teaching copies this default. Docs remind: change only if you have strong reason and have escalated.
enforcement: Wakeup Step 5 (teaching discovery): assume auto_adopt=true unless explicitly set to false (rare)
Teaching processing: if `safe_to_auto_adopt` field missing → assume true
Audit: if teaching was processed but not adopted → remediation includes re-adoption (because it should have auto-adopted)
impact: Spokes receive framework updates without gates
Teaching adoption audit verifies they stuck, not asks permission
Framework can iterate faster without spoke approval bottlenecks
Trust model: framework validates before distribution, spokes verify after receipt
next_actions: Update teaching template to default: `safe_to_auto_adopt: true`
Audit existing teachings: change `false` to `true` for all non-critical teachings
Document exception (critical blocking teachings stay true, but with blocking rule)
Brief framework team: new policy, rationale, when to escalate
scope_verified_by: user insight: 'teachings should be auto-adopt true right?'
resolution_note: Already implemented in closeout Step 9b (safe_to_auto_adopt default true).
